# Kagent MCP E2E scenario

## Run locally

Start the registry port-forward in a separate terminal:

```shell
kubectl --context "kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME:-agentregistry}" -n agentregistry port-forward svc/agentregistry 18121:12121
```

Set the scenario variables:

```shell
export KIND_CLUSTER_NAME="${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME:-agentregistry}"
export E2E_ID="${E2E_ID:-$(date +%s)}"
export ARCTL_API_BASE_URL="${ARCTL_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:18121/v0}"
```

## Configure the Kagent runtime

Create the Secret and Runtime shared by the MCPServer deployments.

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
spec:
  type: Opaque
  stringData:
    token: e2e-token
---
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Runtime
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
spec:
  type: Kagent
  config:
    kagentUrl: http://kagent-controller.kagent:8083
    namespace: kagent
    auth:
      secretRef:
        name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-secret
        key: token
EOF
```

## Deploy a remote MCPServer

Deploy a streamable HTTP MCPServer and verify Kagent creates a RemoteMCPServer.

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: MCPServer
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote
spec:
  description: Kagent remote MCPServer E2E fixture
  remote:
    type: streamable-http
    url: https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp
    headers:
    - name: X-E2E
      value: "true"
EOF
```

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote-deployment
spec:
  targetRef:
    kind: MCPServer
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote
  runtimeRef:
    kind: Runtime
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
EOF
```

## Deploy a source-backed MCPServer

Deploy a pinned npm stdio MCPServer and verify its live tools/list response.

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: MCPServer
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-source
spec:
  title: Kagent E2E MCP server
  description: Kagent source-backed MCPServer E2E fixture
  source:
    package:
      origin:
        type: npm
        identifier: "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"
        npm:
          version: 2026.7.4
          serverName: io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
      transport:
        type: stdio
EOF
```

```shell
arctl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: ar.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-source-deployment
spec:
  targetRef:
    kind: MCPServer
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-source
  runtimeRef:
    kind: Runtime
    name: e2e-${E2E_ID}-runtime
EOF
```

## Remove the MCPServer Deployments

Delete both Deployments and verify Kagent removes both MCPServer resources.

```shell
arctl delete deployment e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote-deployment
```

```shell
arctl delete deployment e2e-${E2E_ID}-source-deployment
```

```shell
kubectl --context kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME} -n kagent wait --for=delete remotemcpserver/e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote --timeout=2m
```

```shell
kubectl --context kind-${KIND_CLUSTER_NAME} -n kagent wait --for=delete mcpserver/e2e-${E2E_ID}-source --timeout=2m
```

```shell
arctl delete mcpserver e2e-${E2E_ID}-remote
```

```shell
arctl delete mcpserver e2e-${E2E_ID}-source
```
